attempt: Freeze old tree footprint columns at their existing height while raising or reshaping surrounding landscape.
reason_failed: The protected tree columns stayed lower than adjacent new ground, creating deep narrow pits and abrupt vertical cuts. User screenshots directly showed trees at the bottom of these artificial depressions.
error_signature: Radial holes around retained trees and unnatural slots on the eastern hamlet hills.
conditions: New heightfield raises terrain around existing vegetation
Canopy and trunk footprints are excluded from height editing
workaround: Compute a continuous terrain surface first, remove complete displaced native tree prefab sources, fill terrain, then place vegetation on the final surface. Preserve architecture separately. Check remaining root-site depressions, actual root support, native block readback and save/reopen.

source_refs.description: keepTrees exclusion in terrain editing caused the discontinuities.
Final surface, tree depression, sightline and horizon checks.
Actual native root contact and filled-terrain checks.
Exact native block verification after restart.
